query: I am registered with the Accounting and Corporate Regulatory Authority (ACRA) as a partner for my business. Am I considered a self-employed person or an employee of the partnership?
reference_answer: For more information on Partnerships, please visit theInland Revenue Authority of Singapore (IRAS) website.
answer: Being registered with ACRA as a partner means you are considered a self-employed person in the partnership. [Document 1]
